payload.intro: You brought me a redberry pie, and I made you a sword from the ore under Ice Mountain. Remember?
payload.prompt: Which sword did I forge for you in The Knight's Sword?
payload.explanation: Thurgo forges a blurite sword from one blurite ore and two iron bars, to replace the one Sir Vyvin's squire lost.

payload.intro: Runite! The finest metal a dwarf can strike. Can you even mine it?
payload.prompt: What Mining level do you need to mine runite ore?
payload.explanation: Runite ore needs 85 Mining, and a mined rock takes twelve minutes to come back.

payload.intro: The toughest rock I know takes a lifetime of swinging a pickaxe. Do you know which?
payload.explanation: Amethyst crystals need 92 Mining and grow only in the Mining Guild.

payload.intro: A runite bar eats a lot of coal in a normal furnace. The Keldagrim lot do it cheaper.
payload.prompt: How much coal does a runite bar take at the Blast Furnace?
payload.explanation: The Blast Furnace needs half the usual coal, so a runite bar takes 4 instead of 8.

payload.intro: A good platebody takes metal, and plenty of it. How many bars, then?
payload.prompt: How many bars does it take to smith a platebody?
payload.explanation: Every metal platebody takes 5 bars of its metal, from bronze to rune.

payload.intro: Kovac's lot need swords taller than a house. Someone has to pour the metal.
payload.prompt: In which minigame do you make swords for Kovac?
payload.explanation: In Giants' Foundry, unlocked by Sleeping Giants, you cast and refine giant swords for Kovac.

payload.intro: Mmyum, for the right price I will help you fix anything you want!
payload.prompt: What is the required Smithing level to repair a broken zombie axe?

payload.intro: Humans often feel the need to simplify things...
payload.prompt: What is the common name for the red-coloured metal orikalkum?

payload.intro: You don't start hammering runite on your first day at the anvil. Learn your metals in order!
payload.prompt: Order these metal bars by the Smithing level required to smelt them, from lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Iron smelts at 15, silver at 20, steel at 30, gold at 40, mithril at 50 and adamantite at 70 (runite at 85).

payload.intro: Without those fancy Keldagrim pedals and conveyor belts, how many lumps of coal does each ore drink up?
payload.prompt: Match each metal bar to the number of coal ores required to smelt it in a regular furnace.
payload.explanation: In a standard furnace, iron needs no coal, steel needs 2, mithril 4, adamantite 6 and runite 8.

payload.intro: Prospector Percy makes you wash his dirt for golden nuggets. What does the old coot actually sell for them?
payload.prompt: Which three of these can be bought from Prospector Percy with golden nuggets?
payload.explanation: Prospector Percy sells the Prospector kit, coal bag, gem bag, soft clay packs and upper-level access. Mining gloves use unidentified minerals, and the celestial ring uses stardust.

payload.intro: Every blueprint on the anvil takes a set number of bars. Don't show up short by one bar!
payload.prompt: Sort these smithed items by how many metal bars are needed to smith one.
payload.explanation: Daggers and med helms take 1 bar; scimitars, longswords, full helms and sq shields take 2; chainbodies, kiteshields, battleaxes, warhammers and 2h swords take 3.

payload.intro: Put on Avan's goldsmith gauntlets and smelt gold bars till your arms fall off. How much XP does each bar give?
payload.prompt: Rounded to the nearest whole number, how much Smithing XP does smelting one gold bar give while wearing goldsmith gauntlets?
payload.explanation: Goldsmith gauntlets increase gold bar smelting experience from 22.5 to 56.2 XP per bar.
